lines: I can't sing an honest song.
Because I end up dressing it up.
Since when has it become this easy?
Did you learn to protect yourself?
The sky visible from the schoolyard.
What color does it appear to you?
Even just pure white clouds.
Sometimes I want to turn them pitch black.
Three minutes Sky chord.
It used to be there back then.
Lost Sky chord.
It's not anyone's fault, it's me.
Surely more than becoming an adult,
there's something precious.
Surely we’ll stay unable to find it.
We keep becoming adults.
I wanted to stay up until morning.
Frustrating childhood.
Now I'm chased by time.
I can't even sleep.
Three minutes Sky chord.
It used to be there back then.
Lost Sky chord.
I want you to teach me.
Surely more than becoming an adult,
there's something precious.
Surely we’ll stay unable to find it.
We keep becoming adults.
I know I can't stay like this forever.
I understand, start walking.
The words I quietly wrote in my notebook
haven't changed at all.
Surely more than becoming an adult,
there's something precious.
Surely we’ll stay unable to find it.
We keep becoming adults.
I can't remain a child.
